changelog:
- Initial release of the Summarize skill, a fast CLI tool for summarizing URLs, local files, and YouTube links.
- Supports multiple content types: URL, PDF, image, audio, and YouTube.
- Allows model selection and API configuration, with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google (Gemini).
- Provides flexible output options, including summary length, JSON formatting, and extraction modes.
- Includes optional config file support and fallback services for web and YouTube extraction.
- Default model set to google/gemini-3-flash-preview if not specified.
summary: 内容摘要工具 - 支持 URL/PDF/图片/音频/YouTube
